meta.title: The New Boy and the Drum

paragraphs: On Monday, a new boy came to Tom's class. He had a small black bag and a clean white shirt. Teacher Nick said, "Please be kind to him." The boy did not smile, and he did not speak to anyone. Some children thought that he was unfriendly. Tom did not know what to think.

At break, Tom and Ben played football with their team. The new boy sat alone under a tree. He had two thin sticks in his hands. He tapped them on his bag, and it made a noisy rhythm. He looked at nobody, and his face was quiet. "Look at his hands," said Tom. "I guess he plays the drum."

Tom walked to the tree and sat next to the boy. "Do you play the drum?" he asked. The boy looked at him for a long time. "Yes," he said quietly. "I played in the school band in my old school." "I miss my friends, and I miss the music." Tom smiled. "I think you are not unfriendly," he said. "I think you are shy."

"Our school band needs a drummer," said Tom. "Please stay with us after lunch." Ben ran to Teacher Nick and asked, "May we borrow a drum from the music room?" "Yes, you may," said Teacher Nick. After lunch, the new boy sat in front of a big drum. He played a fast, strong rhythm, and the music filled the room. The football team came to the door and clapped. "Excellent!" shouted Ben.

The boy smiled for the first time. "Thank you," he said to Tom. "I was afraid, and I did not know anyone here." "Now I am happy." Tom felt happy, and he smiled too. "Do you want to play football tomorrow?" asked Ben. "Yes, please," said the boy. That evening, Tom told his family about the new boy at dinner.
